items.title: A coherent module on a ringed space is of finite presentation and hence quasi-coherent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement deduces finite presentation, and hence quasi-coherence, from coherence on a ringed space (author lemma at source lines 1812-1817, label lemma-coherent-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 1819-1842) unfolds the definition of coherence: the first clause gives local generation of the module by finitely many sections, the second clause gives local generation of the kernel of the resulting surjection, and together they exhibit the presentation by two finite direct sums required by finite presentation (proof lines 1820-1841). The two-step unfolding of the definition is the content. H2.
